title: Put the new checkout page behind a default-off flag

source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: Ship the new checkout template dark so it can be enabled per environment without a deploy.
constraints: Production behaviour must not change until the flag is switched on.
Flags come from environment variables, as for the existing searchV2 flag.
input.context: Web shop (Node.js 20, ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types checked by tsc). Feature flags are read once at startup by loadFlags(); the checkout-v2 template is already deployed.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: asking for percentage rollouts / a flag service, or flag-removal tickets.
